thread:
Maya: quick heads-up: support keeps getting questions about routing changes and unexpected billing when requests drop to fallback capacity. console needs to show auth-origin attribution.
Ryan: agreed, users see different model variants billed and we need a clear trail.
Deva: proposal: auth-resolver emits internal-only headers `x-rwd-auth-path` and `x-rwd-auth-hash` on the request envelope. this won't be visible externally.
Sarah: put it at the auth-proxy to avoid extra RPCs in the hot path. also keep sampling low initially to measure cardinality.
Katie: Console UX: add an "Auth origin" small card on route overview and a global rollup. include an "Explain" modal that links to trace and shows token-exchange vs header resolution.
Maya: rollout plan: debug sampling 0.1% -> 1% -> 10% canary -> full. metrics emitted sampled only.
Ryan: metric idea: `billing.auth_path.tokens` (counter) with labels auth_bucket, model_variant, region. cap cardinality at 100.
Deva: we'll hash SA emails and use short stable IDs for metrics; full mapping reserved for traces/internal store.
Sarah: infra checklist: sampling flag `auth_path_tagging`, metric retention 30d hot, alert on cardinality growth.
Katie: docs: internal note + support FAQ; public changelog mentions "improved internal routing telemetry" only.
Ryan: alerting: page if top auth_bucket token count changes >20% vs 1h baseline for 5m; page if unique auth_bucket cardinality grows >200% in 1h.
Maya: playbook: if spike, flip sampling to 0 and rollback proxy change.
Deva: owners: Deva backend + schema, Maya Console mock, Sarah perf/infrastructure, Ryan alerts, Katie docs. reconvene in 48h.
deploy-bot: "canary deploy started: auth-proxy v2 -> 10%"
Maya: thanks.
